posts.title: Chatting with Schematic: Evaluation of LLMs' Know-How in Electronics
posts.description: This article evaluates the proficiency of 11 contemporary Large Language Models (LLMs) in performing electronic circuit analysis. Utilizing OpenCode , an open-source agentic framework, the LLMs are tasked with analyzing a clock generator’s resistor-capacitor (RC) network defined in a KiCad 9.0 schematic.
